game: NO @ LA, Week 9 2025, kickoff 2025-11-02 16:05 ET, SoFi dome, LA -14, total 44.5

script.base: Morning-of read only: the book has LA leading a controlled dome game, implied totals LA 29.2 / NO 15.2. LA is ahead by halftime and closes with Kyren Williams (39 carries, 169 rush yards in weeks 5-7, about 13 carries and 56 yards a game) against a NO run defense allowing 4.29 YPC and 28 runs of 10+ in 8 games. NO trails by 14, so the run dies: Kamara had just 27 carries for 80 yards in weeks 6-8. Rattler throws into a small pie, and the ball goes to the primary option, Olave (29 targets, 259 yards, 391 air yards in that same window). Total 44.5 is not a shootout.
script.flip1: Competitive game: NO hangs around, LA cannot just kill clock, Nacua/Adams stay live, and Kamara's recent 9-carry role ticks up enough to threaten a 36.5 rush under. This is the flip that kills a Kamara under and revives LA WR overs.
script.flip2: Blowout past the 14: LA starter pass volume stalls (Nacua's 101.5 and Adams's 56.5 get fragile) and Blake Corum (18 carries, 73 yards in weeks 5-7; most recent rush line in that window 37) vultures late carries from Kyren. NO attempts rise but efficiency can collapse (NO EPA/dropback -0.19 vs no blitz), so empty yards may not reach every skill player.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game nflverse report only; final inactives (~90 min pre-kick) are not in the pack. LA CB Darious Williams Doubtful (shoulder): if he sits, NO WRs face a backup — helps Olave (29 targets / 259 yards weeks 6-8) and Shaheed (27/143) more than the run game. NO WR Rashid Shaheed Questionable (hip): if limited or out, targets funnel to Olave and Juwan Johnson (17 targets, 147 yards); Cooks (6 targets, 46 yards) and Vele (5/10) are thin next men, not a clean over. NO RB Alvin Kamara Questionable (ankle): already a 9-carry, 27-yard back in weeks 6-8; Kendre Miller is next man (pack: 9 carries, 28 yards in that window) but Miller's last four rush lines are 65, 41, 21, 7, so a Kamara scratch is only a Miller sleeper if he is confirmed up and the 24.5/32.5 numbers have not moved — no prices are saved, so that check fails. NO DT John Ridgeway Questionable (illness): small LA run boost if he sits, not enough to override Kyren's 66.5 being above a 56-yard recent pace. NO CB Alontae Taylor Questionable (shoulder): if out, Adams (28 targets, 162 yards weeks 5-7) and Nacua face a backup, which cuts against LA WR unders. No OL names on the report.

Cleanest run overlap is Kyren vs 4.29 YPC, but 169 rush yards on 39 carries in 3 games (56.3/game) sits under a 66.5 stand-in, with Corum taking 18 carries.

Two 98-yard Olave games can be the ceiling, not the new normal; Kamara's rush downtrend is four straight and matches the carry count.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Olave lost because the 15.2 team total was real: Rattler was under -0.19 EPA pressure-free, LA's middle and right (5.27 and 5.03 YPA) took away the volume, Williams played through the doubtful tag, and the two 98-yard games did not repeat — he finished 59-or-worse the way the barely-clearing 59 and 63 already hinted, with Johnson (most recent 53) taking the seam. Kamara lost because the ankle was a decoy, the game stayed inside one score (flip 1), and a light box plus NO's own willingness to run produced the one 15-yard carry LA almost never allows, pushing 21-31 yards up through 36.5 — or he was inactive and the ticket voided, which is a process miss if we treated a questionable tag as a locked under. The counter-case is real but not stronger than the role-and-front read, so both stay leans, not bets.
slip_story: One story only: LA controls a dome game, NO trails and throws to Olave while Kamara's already-thin rush role stays under against a 3.95 YPC front. Those two win together. Do not mix in a total under with other same-game overs, a Kyren rush over (form fights the script), a Nacua/Adams over (needs the competitive flip and Taylor out), or a Miller over (needs Kamara out). No TD legs. Slip is the two leans above, unsized, pending inactives and a real price.
